summary: Expro Group Holdings N.V. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing senior secured revolving credit facility. The amendment, entered into on May 8, 2026, increases revolving loan commitments from $400 million to $450 million and eliminates the $100 million term bridge loan commitment. No other changes, such as price, premium, or strategic transaction, are mentioned. This is purely a credit facility modification and does not constitute a special situation. The filing is routine, lacking any event triggering activist, M&A, restructuring, or similar categories.
